name.en: Ramming single-post fixed-tilt table (C-pile, section not stated)
name.es: Mesa fija con pilote de hincado de un poste (pilote C, sección no indicada)

description.en: Fixed-tilt ground table on a single galvanized post rammed into the soil, with a galvanized table frame and aluminium module clamps. The ArcelorMittal source describes a single-post ramming system and does not state the post section. A generic C-pile reference size (approximate, from an industry article) is recorded for orientation only; it is not confirmed for this product.
description.es: Mesa fija de tilt en suelo sobre un poste galvanizado hincado, con bastidor galvanizado y mordazas de aluminio para módulos. La fuente de ArcelorMittal describe un sistema de poste único hincado y no indica la sección del poste. Se registra una dimensión de referencia genérica de pilote C (aproximada, de un artículo del sector) solo como orientación; no está confirmada para este producto.

typical_use: Fixed-tilt ground arrays on soils suitable for ramming, with tilt 0-30 degrees.

profiles.name: Generic C-pile reference section (approximate; not confirmed for this product)

geometry.description: Only sourced values are modelled: ground clearance 500 mm and one post per table (ArcelorMittal). The post section is a generic C reference (approximate, unverified); post length and embedment are not stated.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module row, y up-slope/north-south horizontal, z up; origin at ground/roof contact of first support; mm and degrees

elements.note: Ground clearance of the table stated in the source (module lower edge height above ground), not a post length.
One post per table (ArcelorMittal: single post). Length and embedment not stated; length_mm 0 is a placeholder, not a value. Section is the generic C reference above.

reference_layout.note: Source: 2 modules in portrait or 4 modules in landscape per table; table length customizable. Module dimensions not stated.
